SELECT 
  (SUM(CZK_consumption) - SUM(EUR_consumption)) AS consumption_difference
FROM
  (
    SELECT 
      SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS CZK_consumption
    FROM 
      customers
    JOIN 
      yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
    WHERE 
      customers.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
      SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) AS EUR_consumption
    FROM 
      customers
    JOIN 
      yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
    WHERE 
      customers.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  ) AS subquery

  SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
  yearmonth
GROUP BY 
  SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY 
  TotalConsumption DESC

FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME')
AND Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) || SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2)

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(y.C Consumption) AS AnnualConsumption
  FROM 
    customers c
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment
),
LowestConsumptionSegments AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    SUM(y.C Consumption) AS AnnualConsumption
  FROM 
    customers c
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    AND c.CustomerID IN (
      SELECT 
        CustomerID
      FROM 
        customers
      WHERE 
        CustomerID IN (
          SELECT 
            CustomerID
          FROM 
            yearmonth
          WHERE 
            SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
          GROUP BY 
            CustomerID
          HAVING 
            SUM(Consumption) = (
              SELECT 
                MIN(SUM(Consumption))
              FROM 
                yearmonth
              WHERE 
                SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
              GROUP BY 
                CustomerID
            )
        )
    )
  GROUP BY 
    c.Segment
)
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'SME' AND s2.Segment = 'LAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'LAM' AND s2.Segment = 'KAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  (s1.AnnualConsumption - s2.AnnualConsumption) AS Difference
FROM 
  SegmentConsumption s1
JOIN 
  SegmentConsumption s2 ON s1.Segment = 'KAM' AND s2.Segment = 'SME'

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
    SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
  FROM yearmonth
  GROUP BY CustomerID, SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4)
),
eur_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerID,
    TotalConsumption
  FROM yearly_consumption
  WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
  )
),
segment_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    eur_customers.CustomerID,
    eur_customption.TotalConsumption,
    eur_customption.Year
  FROM eur_customers
  JOIN customers c ON eur_customers.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
),
change_in_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.Segment,
    sc.CustomerID,
    sc.Year AS Year,
    sc.TotalConsumption AS Consumption,
    LEAD(sc.TotalConsumption, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY sc.CustomerID ORDER BY sc.Year) AS NextYearConsumption
  FROM segment_consumption sc
),
percentage_change AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    CustomerID,
    Year,
    (NextYearConsumption - Consumption) / NULLIF(NextYearConsumption, 0) * 100 AS PercentageChange
  FROM change_in_consumption
  WHERE Year = '2012'
),
segment_percentage_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    AVG(PercentageChange) AS AvgPercentageChange
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
  Segment,
  AvgPercentageChange,
  CASE 
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MAX(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 'Biggest'
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MIN(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 'Lowest'
  END AS IncreaseType
FROM segment_percentage_changes
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MAX(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 1
    WHEN AvgPercentageChange = (SELECT MIN(AvgPercentageChange) FROM segment_percentage_changes) THEN 2
  END

WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID), 2) AS percentage_women
FROM 
  Patient
JOIN 
  Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE 
  strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%'

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS UricAcidNormal
FROM 
  Patient p
JOIN 
  Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE 
  p.ID = 57266

SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.GPT >= 60

SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 60
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29

SELECT 
  Patient.SEX, 
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS Patients
FROM 
  Patient
JOIN 
  Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE 
  Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY 
  Patient.SEX

SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(Patient.Birthday) / 365.25) AS AverageAge
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
AND SUBSTR(CURRENT_DATE, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) > 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250

SELECT 
  p.ID, 
  p.SEX, 
  CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.Birthday) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM 
  Patient p
JOIN 
  Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE 
  l.GLU >= 180 
  AND l.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT 
  p.ID, 
  CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.Birthday) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age, 
  p.Diagnosis
FROM 
  Patient p
WHERE 
  p.ID IN (
    SELECT 
      l.ID
    FROM 
      Laboratory l
    WHERE 
      l.RBC < 3.5
  )

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND e.HGB > 10
  AND e.HGB < 17
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.ID, 
       CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(p.Birthday) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) >= 2

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT < 100) AS lower_than_normal,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT > 400) AS higher_than_normal

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = 1984
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(p.Birthday)) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN PT >= 14 AND SEX = 'F' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN PT >= 14 THEN 1 END), 2) AS percentage_female_with_abnormal_PT
FROM 
  Patient
JOIN 
  Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE 
  (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) > 55

FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID

AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.`First Date` >= '1990-01-01'

  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500

FROM Laboratory
WHERE IGM <= 40 OR IGM >= 400
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE CRP = '+' AND Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.ID)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

    SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

  Player.player_name,

  COUNT(*) AS total_matches
FROM 
  Match m
JOIN 
  League l ON m.league_id = l.id

SELECT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes

FROM Team_Attributes ta

FROM Player

FROM Player_Attributes pa

FROM Match M

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (CAST((SELECT overall_rating FROM Player p1 
           JOIN Player_Attributes pa1 ON p1.player_api_id = pa1.player_api_id

            JOIN Player_Attributes pa1 ON p1.player_api_id = pa1.player_api_id

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (1 - (CAST(fastest_lap_speed_854 AS REAL) / CAST(fastest_lap_speed_853 AS REAL))) * 100, 
    2
  ) AS percent_faster
FROM (
  SELECT 
    r1.fastest_lap_speed AS fastest_lap_speed_853,
    r2.fastest_lap_speed AS fastest_lap_speed_854
  FROM 
    results r1
    JOIN results r2 ON r1.raceId = 853 AND r2.raceId = 854
    JOIN drivers d ON r1.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE 
    d.forename = 'Paul' 
    AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
    AND r1.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
    AND r2.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN time IS NOT NULL THEN driverId END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS completion_rate
FROM 
  results
JOIN 
  races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE 
  races.date = '1983-07-16'

  drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId

  results ON drivers.driverId = results.driverId

  races ON results.raceId = races.raceId

  driverStandings rs ON d.driverId = rs.driverId

WITH client_loan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client c ON a.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status = 'A'
),
account_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.date AS trans_date,
    t.balance
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1993-03-22' AND '1998-12-27'
),
client_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.trans_date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_1993_03_22,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.trans_date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_1998_12_27
  FROM account_balance t
  JOIN client_loan cl ON t.account_id = cl.client_id
  GROUP BY c.client_id
)
SELECT 
  ((balance_1998_12_27 - balance_1993_03_22) * 100.0 / balance_1993_03_22) AS increase_rate
FROM client_balance
WHERE balance_1993_03_22 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1998_12_27 IS NOT NULL
